research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Instacart is researching online concierge and shopping systems that optimize grocery ordering, picking, and delivery. Work such as Machine Learning Model for Click Through Rate Prediction Using Three Vector and Delivery Time Estimation Using an Attribute-Based Prediction of a Difference focuses on ranking items and estimating delivery times. Efforts like Machine learning model for dynamically boosting order delivery time and Picking sequence optimization within a warehouse for an item list enhance fulfillment logistics, shopper allocation, and warehouse navigation.

overview_description.description: Instacart is a grocery delivery startup that delivers in as short as an hour. It focuses on delivering groceries and home essentials, Instacart already has over 500,000 items from local stores in its catalogue. Customers can choose from a variety of local stores including Safeway, Whole Foods, Super Fresh, Harris Teeter, Shaw's, Mariano's, Jewel-Osco, Stanley's, and Costco. Customers can mix items from multiple stores into one order. Instacart has raised funding from Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers, Andreessen Horowitz, Sequoia Capital, Y Combinator, Khosla Ventures, and Canaan Partners among other participants.

about_short_description.short_description: Instacart is an online grocery platform that offers same-day delivery and pickup services for retailers and consumers.

product.name: Instacart Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace that lets consumers browse and order groceries and retail products from local and national retailers through the website or mobile app.

product.name: Instacart Delivery
product.description: A same-day delivery service in which personal shoppers select products from participating stores and deliver orders to consumers, with options for substitutions, tracking, and contactless drop-off.

product.name: Instacart Pickup
product.description: A curbside and in-store pickup service that lets customers order products online and collect prepared orders at participating retail locations.

product.name: Instacart Consumer App and Website
product.description: Digital ordering platforms for browsing retailer catalogs, placing delivery or pickup orders, communicating with shoppers, managing substitutions, and tracking fulfillment.

product.name: Instacart+
product.description: A paid membership program offering $0 delivery fees on eligible grocery, retail, Costco, and restaurant orders subject to minimum order values and service fees.

product.name: Instacart Business
product.description: Business ordering and delivery services for workplace food, snacks, office supplies, employee gifting, and other business purchasing needs.
